name: microstructure_reversion_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, each 5-second bar's close location value (CLV) — how close the bar's close is to its high relative to the bar's range — approximates intra-bar buying vs selling pressure. When 20 consecutive 5-second bars (100 seconds) show more than 68% buy-side volume dominance and NIFTY has simultaneously risen 0.15%+ above where it was 100 seconds ago, institutional market-order buyers have systematically absorbed available limit-sell orders from the book. The moment the rolling buy imbalance fraction begins declining (sellers returning to quote), aggressive accumulation has exhausted near-side supply and NIFTY reverts toward session VWAP as one-sided institutional flow subsides.
core_signal_oneliner: CLV-based 100-second buy imbalance fraction exceeding 68% (or below 32%) with a price move confirmation, then inflecting back, signaling order flow exhaustion
